purpose: Independent real-market test of the existing conditional-path momentum architecture, refitted on SPY. This is not a CGB validation or the complete six-notebook Fractal strategy.
bar_clock: Provider timestamp is bar start. Decision time is start plus five minutes; this is an assumed completed-bar research clock, not measured historical API receipt time.
calendar: XNYS regular sessions from exchange_calendars, including early closes
quality_rule: Keep a session for modelling only when every expected regular-session bar has finite positive consistent OHLC and finite positive volume. No forward fill. Publish every excluded session and reason. This completeness selection is a retrospective data-quality restriction, not a live filter.
split_rule: First 60 percent of retained sessions TRAIN, next 20 percent CAL, last 20 percent TEST; integer floors for first two. Same sessions for all horizons; exclude an origin when its target extends past that session.
volatility: 60-minute sample standard deviation of five-minute close changes, lagged one bar; floor 0.25 cents
neutral_band: 0.35 times origin prior volatility times square root of horizon bars
state_rule: Five states: balanced, up-responsive, up-weakening, down-responsive, down-weakening; direction threshold 0.75 on normalized30-minute move, weakening when directional5-minute drift is less than half directional30-minute drift; maintain past-only state age
features: Price momentum/distribution; state and age; time within session; bar-volume ratio; explicitly approximate bar-VWAP distance. No spread, signed flow, book, rates, swaps or participant classification.
model: Existing XGBoost future-state and endpoint-class heads; TRAIN transition table; TRAIN normalized empirical future-path bank; group-balanced local neighborhoods; CAL state blend and three-path-expert mixture
primary_metric: Session-balanced three-class log loss on every eligible TEST origin
secondary_metrics: endpoint mean absolute error in cents
uncertainty: Paired session-average loss differences with 2000 five-session moving-block bootstrap replications; deterministic seed1729; exploratory comparisons, no multiple-testing correction
path_risk: Adverse extrema from future bars only (origin+1 through target), using OHLC lows/highs; excludes the already completed origin bar. No within-bar ordering, fills or PnL is inferred.
replay_selection: First complete TEST session, fixed12:00 ET default cutoff; not selected for profit or model agreement
costs: No executable performance or net returns without quotes. This run evaluates predictions, not an execution strategy.
data_storage: Credentials and raw data remain local and ignored by Git; publish reproducible code and aggregate diagnostics.
test_policy: Freeze choices before evaluating TEST. Report first-run results; do not optimise this protocol against TEST. Any follow-up requires a new experiment identity and new holdout.
